# Getting help

Acer H340 for Linux has one maintainer. Help is best effort.

- **How do I install it?** Read [INSTALL.md](../INSTALL.md) and the FAQ in the [README](../README.md).
- **A question:** search the [existing issues](https://github.com/ehsanenaloo/Acer-h340-linux/issues), then open one with the [question form](https://github.com/ehsanenaloo/Acer-h340-linux/issues/new/choose).
- **Bugs and feature requests:** use the same [issue forms](https://github.com/ehsanenaloo/Acer-h340-linux/issues/new/choose).
- **Security problems:** follow [SECURITY.md](SECURITY.md). Do not use public issues.
- **Contributing:** read [CONTRIBUTING.md](CONTRIBUTING.md).

Do not paste passwords, keys or private data into an issue.
